prose: Basis: the Daring Fireball link post quoting Reuters; the Reuters article itself was not fetched. Reuters reports that an OpenAI employee who left for Apple sent more than 100 files about an unreleased product to a personal account, and later presented the unreleased product to senior Apple leadership, according to a new filing in the OpenAI-Apple lawsuit.

The filing, in US federal court in San Jose, alleges the presentation happened months ago and that Apple is now making a product based on what it learned. The Daring Fireball headline frames Apple's denial as a schoolyard retort.
highlights: OpenAI filing: ex-employee took 100+ files on an unreleased product to Apple
Employee allegedly presented the product to senior Apple leadership
Case in US federal court, San Jose
Basis: Daring Fireball's quote of Reuters; original not fetched
